import os
import importlib.util
import unittest

TARGET_CODE_PATH = os.environ['TARGET_CODE_PATH']
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('target_module', TARGET_CODE_PATH)
target = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(target)
compact_whitespace = target.compact_whitespace

class TestCompactWhitespace(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic(self):
        lines = ["  hello  ", "", "  ", "  world  "]
        expected = ["hello", "world"]
        result = compact_whitespace(lines)
        self.assertEqual(result, expected)
        
    def test_no_empty_lines(self):
        lines = ["  ", " "]
        expected = []
        result = compact_whitespace(lines)
        self.assertEqual(result, expected)

    def test_preserves_order(self):
        lines = ["b", "  ", "a", "c  "]
        expected = ["b", "a", "c"]
        result = compact_whitespace(lines)
        self.assertEqual(result, expected)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
